envelope.description: Qualify real concurrent worker isolation and failure recovery

body.title: Qualify real concurrent worker isolation and failure recovery
body.summary: Compose the production entrypoints in real-worker integration fixtures covering code/code, design/design and mixed reviews from same/different sessions, plus targeted crash/cancellation/cleanup cases. Use deterministic barriers and fake native/provider fixtures, not repeated cloud reviews.
acceptanceChecks: A durably acknowledged worker blocked in CPU/admission work cannot prevent daemon status, its own cached progress or an independent review from completing before the barrier is released.
Valid reviews have distinct runtime threadIds; duplicate same-review start is non-spawning and stale/forged owner messages cannot alter another worker.
Never-ready/pre-save-hung boot, worker death across native-spawn/save boundaries, controller disconnect, observer disconnect and daemon restart retain targeted semantics.
Whole-history resource fences and clearance/publication/cleanup replay are exercised through real routing; unrelated review files and processes remain untouched.
Run existing relevant ownership/admission/progress/checkpoint/recovery/publication/approval suites alongside these regressions with no live-cloud requirement.
